remarks: Move right in and enjoy this exceptionally bright and welcoming four-level townhouse offering two bedrooms, two and a half baths, and beautifully flexible living space throughout. Abundant natural light showcases the gleaming Brazilian Cherry hardwood floors and thoughtfully updated interiors. The eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances and marble counters is ready for everyday living and easy entertaining. Just beyond, the inviting living room features beautiful custom lighted built-ins and a wood-burning fireplace with a sleek marble hearth. Step outside to the terrace with Trex decking, an ideal spot for grilling, dining alfresco, or simply enjoying your morning coffee. Upstairs, the primary suite is a peaceful retreat with a soaring cathedral ceiling, generous double closets, and spacious ensuite bath with marble countertop. A generous second bedroom with ample closet space, full bath, and laundry area complete the bedroom level. The sun-filled third-floor loft adds another layer of versatility and is ideal for a home office, den, reading room, or exercise space. On the lower level, a spacious family room offers even more possibilities as an office, media room, playroom, fitness room, or simply an enormous mudroom. From here, enjoy direct access to the generous two-car garage, newly finished in 2026 with a commercial-grade epoxy floor and storage closet.
